programme.title: Cinta Di balik Awan S1 E1
programme.desc: Razi, yang baru saja putus dengan Jessica, merasa tidak ada gunanya bekerja keras sebagai fotografer majalah. Di tengah gejolak batinnya, Razi bertemu Jane yang menawarkan pekerjaan sampingan sebagai paparazi. Akhirnya ia menerima tawaran tersebut, meskipun awalnya ingin mundur karena risikonya terlalu berbahaya. Razi kemudian pergi ke Yogyakarta bersama Jane. Awalnya, ia berniat membantu Jane menemui seorang dukun untuk melakukan sesuatu terhadap selingkuhan ayah Jane. Namun, tanpa diduga keduanya mengalami petualangan seru dan menegangkan saat disandera oleh sekte sesat Kerajaan Ilahi Kamilia di Gunung Kidul. Akibat kebersamaan dalam situasi penuh penderitaan itu, benih-benih cinta antara Razi dan Jane mulai tumbuh.

programme.title: Joe & Robot Kopi S1 E1
programme.desc: Parallel cut Joe dan Clara di sebuah pagi di rumah masing-masing, siap beraktivitas. Tak lama, di kedai kopi Joe yang riuh, Joe tiba dan menyelesaikan masalah diantrian. Terlihat Rori si robot kopi yang melayani pelanggan dan memutar musik sesuai selera pengunjung. Tak lama Clara tiba menyeruak antrian, membuat pengunjung lain protes, namun ia disambut Joe yang adalah teman lamanya. Mereka pun saling menyapa dan pergi menyusuri jalanan Surabaya untuk mengenang masa lalu kala pertama Clara melihat Joe saling bertemu.

programme.title: Beyond Creator Indonesian Youtubers S1 E1
programme.desc: Cameo Project, Bayu Skak, dan SkinnyIndonesian24—tiga nama besar yang menjadi pelopor YouTube Indonesia dengan kanal yang sangat berpengaruh dan berdampak besar. Saat ini, banyak orang dapat dengan mudah meraih popularitas dalam waktu singkat. Hal tersebut tidaklah salah, namun menjadi dipertanyakan ketika popularitas, kekuatan, dan pengaruh tersebut tidak dimanfaatkan secara bijak.

programme.title: Beyond Creator Indonesian Youtubers S1 E2
programme.desc: Tim2one yang dikenal secara regional—atau Chandra Liow—memulai kanalnya dari video tutorial After Effects saat ia masih duduk di bangku SMP. Harbatah, yang sebelumnya dikenal sebagai Duo Harbatah, kini menjadi kanal yang dikenal luas dan pada awalnya memparodikan budaya Arab.

programme.title: Beyond Creator Indonesian Youtubers S1 E3
programme.desc: Kenalkan Rivaldo Santosa, sosok di balik kanal YouTube Detective Aldo yang dikenal luas karena membahas secara mendalam topik okultisme, kriminalitas, serta berbagai aspek sejarah Indonesia. Lalu ada Nessie Judge yang terkenal, seorang perempuan muda yang gemar membagikan fakta, cerita, dan informasi menarik kepada Nerrorists—sebutan khas untuk para pengikutnya.

programme.title: Beyond Creator Indonesian Youtubers S1 E4
programme.desc: Menampilkan grup musik Eclat Story (Yosua Gunawan, Yeshua Abraham, dan Louis Xander Liang), Rani Ramadhany, serta Eka Gustiwana—bagi mereka, musik adalah inti dari semangat dalam berkarya. programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Setelah sukses menyutradarai film pertamanya, Let's Make Laugh, Alfred Cheung King-tin menyajikan film komedi bertema benturan budaya ketika seorang petani asal Tiongkok Daratan memboyong keluarganya ke Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Kung-Fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang adalah seorang seniman bela diri terkenal yang dipaksa untuk mengajarkan kung fu ke Klan Mong, sebuah klan jahat yang mencoba menghancurkan musuh bebuyutannya, Klan Chow.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping dan Su adalah sepasang kekasih yang mengelola agen perjalanan khusus liburan ke Asia Tenggara. Seorang kepala sekolah bernama Tung beserta murid-muridnya bergabung dalam tur yang dipimpin oleh Ping.

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: Keluarga seorang pemimpin Anti-Ching yang dibunuh kabur ke kota kecil yang dihuni oleh para pelajar yang saling bersaing dan sejumlah pelatih olahraga yang tangguh. Namun, salah satu guru ternyata adalah agen rahasia.

programme.title: Tales Of Larceny
programme.desc: Li Han Hsiang menulis dan menyutradarai Tales of Larceny, kisah tentang tipu muslihat dan permainan licik di era panglima perang Tiongkok yang korup, dibintangi aktor-aktor karakter terbaik dari Shaw Brothers.

programme.title: What Price Honesty
programme.desc: Dalam film laga yang menegangkan ini, Danny Lee, Jason Pai dan Sun Chien berperan sebagai penegak hukum baru. Namun, tugas mereka untuk membasmi kejahatan dihalangi oleh atasan mereka yang korup.

programme.title: The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: Penduduk Kota Liu terpaksa melarikan diri saat geng Macan Hitam yang kejam menyerang kota. Namun, para penduduk berhasil menyembunyikan semua emas dan harta mereka di sebuah lembah.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: David jatuh cinta pada Dan Feng dan menikahinya. Saudari David yang bernama Mona jatuh cinta dengan sahabatnya, Han Ming. Karena cemburu, Mona berbohong tentang perselingkuhan antara Han Ming dan Dan Feng.

programme.title: Tales Of A Eunuch
programme.desc: Film ini berkisah tentang perjuangan seorang berandal terkenal, yang gemar berjudi dan terlibat masalah dengan para penjahat dan pemberontak, dalam mencari sebuah naskah khusus Buddha.

programme.title: Tales Of A Eunuch
programme.desc: Film ini berkisah tentang perjuangan seorang berandal terkenal, yang gemar berjudi dan terlibat masalah dengan para penjahat dan pemberontak, dalam mencari sebuah naskah khusus Buddha.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: Kisah nyata tentang industri film Hong Kong yang disutradarai oleh Li Han Hsiang ini menggambarkan saat-saat paling menyenangkan dan paling aktual di suatu era seperti yang dimuat dalam kolom gosip surat kabar.

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: Keluarga Yang telah melayani negara selama beberapa generasi pada masa Dinasti Song. Sang kepala keluarga mempimpin sebuah balas dendam dan membela negara saat Jenderal Yang terbunuh dalam perang di Jin Shan.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Beberapa bintang wanita terbesar Shaw Brothers di tahun 1970-an tampil bersama dalam kisah tentang cinta dan orangtua yang terlampau ikut campur. Dibintangi oleh Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei dan Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: Ratu Kung-Fu asal Hong Kong, Cheng Pei-pei, berperan sebagai pendekar pedang wanita yang melakukan misi untuk membalas dendam atas kematian orangtuanya dan menyelamatkan negara dari penjajah asing.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: Pada masa kemunduran Dinasti Ching, putra dari hakim lokal membunuh seorang pedagang keliling dan memperkosa istrinya. Sang istri dijebak atas pembunuhan suaminya oleh sang pemerkosa.

programme.title: Vengeance Is A Golden Blade
programme.desc: Istri Pengiring Master Li berselingkuh dengan saingannya yang bernama Long, ia berencana untuk mencuri Pedang Emas Li dan membunuhnya serta putrinya yang masih kecil.

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: Dua pemuda bergabung dengan kelompok pemberontak setelah Revolusi Tiongkok tahun 1911 dan tak sengaja menjadi pahlawan. Dibantu oleh seorang putri panglima perang, mereka berhasil membantu pemberontak mencuri senjata.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Berlatar pada malam penyerbuan Jepang di Hong Kong, film tentang kisah cinta yang tragis produksi Shaw Brothers ini dibintangi oleh Li Ting dan Kwan Shan sebagai sepasang kekasih yang terpisahkan oleh perang.

programme.title: The Web Of Death
programme.desc: Demi menguasai dunia seni bela diri, Kepala Sekte Ular berusaha mendapatkan 'Five Poison Web' nan mematikan, dan menyebarkan desas-desus tentang keberadaannya. Xiong dan Kit pun ditugaskan untuk menyelidikinya.

programme.title: Return Of The Phoenix
programme.desc: Return Of The Phoenix adalah karya besar lain dari sutradara Li Han-hsiang. Sebuah film komedi seputar peristiwa-peristiwa menjelang pernikahan putri sang perdana menteri.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: Li Ching adalah gadis berumur 17 tahun yang menikahi gurunya yang berumur 35 tahun. Kelucuan terjadi ketika Li memutuskan untuk bersekolah di tempat sang suami bekerja dan berupaya menutupi hubungan mereka.

programme.title: The Knight Of Knights
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, pemimpin tujuh ksatria, mengirim enam saudara angkatnya untuk menyelidiki sebuah biara. Namun, mereka dibunuh oleh seorang kepala biara yang berencana membunuh Inspektur Lin.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: Raja Naga dikunci dalam segel oleh Tuan Naga selama 500 tahun, dan putri sang Raja harus kembali ke masa lalu guna membunuh Tuan Naga saat mengetahui bahwa keduanya adalah teman dekat di masa lalu.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, putra dari pengusaha yang culun, mendapat kekecewaan usai mencari jodoh di Hawaii bersama temannya. Kemudian, secara tak sengaja mereka terjebak dalam sebuah pertukaran identitas yang kacau.

programme.title: Face To Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu tewas dalam sebuah kecelakaan ski. Kemudian, teman sekamarnya, Yoshio, menikahi istrinya serta mewarisi seluruh kekayaannya. Namun, segalanya berubah sejak Yoshio bertemu seorang pria tua di pemakaman Tamotsu.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Ip Man menerima sebuah tantangan bertarung dari master asal utara yang sudah tua bernama Gong Yu Tian dan berhasil memenangkannya. Namun, ia dikalahkan oleh putri sang master, Gong Er, dan jatuh cinta padanya.

programme.title: Get In The Dark
programme.desc: Nona Qiao meninggal secara tak wajar dan kepala pelayannya membayar seorang perajin untuk membuat sebuah boneka kertas. Serangkaian peristiwa nan mengerikan terjadi saat arwah Nona Qiao bangkit untuk membalas dendam.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Bintang laga Chow Yun-Fat memerankan gangster sungguhan Chen Daqi saat ia naik ke eselon atas kekuasaan, mendapati dirinya terpecah antara cinta dua wanita, rencana pembunuhan dinas rahasia, dan ancaman perang yang membayangi.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 2
programme.desc: Sing mengundurkan diri dari kepolisian setelah diturunkan pangkatnya ke bagian pengaturan lalu lintas, sementara rekannya ditugaskan dalam misi yang melibatkan teroris asing yang mengancam akan mengebom sebuah sekolah di Hong Kong, sehingga Sing memutuskan untuk membantu dengan menyamar di sekolah yang sama.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 2
programme.desc: Sing mengundurkan diri dari kepolisian setelah diturunkan pangkatnya ke bagian pengaturan lalu lintas, sementara rekannya ditugaskan dalam misi yang melibatkan teroris asing yang mengancam akan mengebom sebuah sekolah di Hong Kong, sehingga Sing memutuskan untuk membantu dengan menyamar di sekolah yang sama.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: Seorang pengusaha serakah dari Hong Kong menyewa seorang pemburu muda untuk menangkap gorila raksasa yang konon hidup jauh di dalam hutan India. Pemburu itu menemukan kera tersebut, dan hidup bersamanya ia menemukan seorang wanita liar yang telah berteman dengan makhluk itu.

programme.title: Behind The Yellow Line
programme.desc: Seorang pria muda yang pemalu dan pekerja kantoran, bertemu dengan seorang wanita cantik dan ambisius yang sedang mengejar karirnya, serta seorang pria lain yang ramah namun penuh rahasia. Pertemuan ini membawa mereka ke dalam perjalanan emosional yang kompleks, penuh dengan kebingungan, kesalahpahaman, dan penemuan diri.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agen Wen ditugaskan untuk menyamar sebagai pedagang senjata militer di Asia Tenggara guna menemukan beberapa amunisi dan menghancurkannya. Namun, ia diserang oleh gangster tak dikenal saat menemukan amunisi tersebut.

programme.title: Furious Attack
programme.desc: Seorang mantan tentara pasukan khusus menyusup ke Myanmar utara untuk menyelamatkan putrinya yang hilang, melawan geng penipu dan pedagang organ dalam pertarungan terakhir dengan bos kriminal tersebut.

programme.title: Out Of The Dark (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Seorang wanita tua tewas setelah terjatuh dari sebuah gedung dan arwahnya menghantui tempat tersebut. Merasa ketakutan, para penjaga keamanan setempat pun meminta bantuan Leo si pemburu hantu beserta asistennya.

programme.title: The Viral Factor (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Agen Jon mempertimbangkan untuk meninggalkan kepolisian sampai dia mengetahui bahwa saudara laki-lakinya bekerja sebagai tentara bayaran untuk mantan rekan kerjanya yang mengkhianati tim mereka.

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Seorang polisi yang berdedikasi dihantui rasa bersalah karena telah menyelamatkan nyawa seorang pemimpin geng. Ia kemudian terobsesi untuk menghancurkan sindikat kejahatan yang dipimpin oleh pria yang pernah diselamatkannya.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: Sebuah upaya pembunuhan yang gagal di Harbin, Cina pada tahun 1909 mengubah arah sejarah. Kini dua agen JBI harus menemukan hubungan antara benda tersebut dengan sebuah artefak Korea kuno.

programme.desc: Selama invasi Jepang ke Cina, seorang seniman bela diri yang kaya terpaksa meninggalkan rumahnya ketika kotanya diduduki. Dengan sedikit sarana untuk memenuhi kebutuhan mereka sendiri, Ip Man dan anggota kota yang tersisa harus menemukan cara untuk bertahan hidup.

programme.title: The Evolution Of The Premier League Goalkeepper : The Art Of...
programme.desc: Peter and Kasper Schmeichel explore how the art of goalkeeping has evolved throughout the Premier League era. Featuring some of the Premier League's greatest number ones, the show examines how one of football's most specialised positions has been transformed.

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu
programme.desc: Menceritakan kisah seorang gadis bernama Sakinah yang menjalani hidup penuh tekanan karena fitnah dan dipaksa menikah dengan orang yang tidak mencintainya. Tidak hanya itu, Sakinah bahkan dihalangi untuk tau siapa Ibu kandung yang tega membuangnya. Bagaimana kelanjutan kisah hidup Sakinah?

programme.title: Ketika Jamu Tak Berhenti Di Sini
programme.desc: kehidupan seorang gadis bernama Molly (Djihan Ranti). Demi mencukupi kebutuhan sehari-hari, Molly dan adiknya berjualan jamu instan di dalam botol di kampus. Usaha Molly dan adiknya itu pun mendapatkan perhatian dari teman-teman kampusnya hingga jamunya banyak dibeli dan pemasarannya dibantu temannya. Meski demikian, Molly masih kesulitan dalam memenuhi kebutuhan hidupnya hingga membayar kos pun ditagih-tagih. Suatu hari, ada peristiwa yang mendekatkan Molly dengan seorang pria bernama Vian (Julian Jacob). Molly dan Vian pun menjadi dekat hingga menimbulkan kecemburuan pacar Vian.

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. Sampai akhirnya sang buah hati Zahra divonis menderita sakit yang serius ditengah keluarga mereka yang masih serba kekurangan. Disaat bersamaan, Fathir tidak sengaja bertemu dengan mantannya Clara. Kehadiran Clara mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Katanya Hidup Itu Indah
programme.desc: Cakra (Munggaran Meldrat) harus kehilangan kakak dan kakak iparnya yang meninggal dunia dan meninggalkan 3 anak yang masih kecil. Demi memenuhi kewajibannya sebagai tulang punggung, Cakra pun bekerja serabutan. Saat sedang berjualan keliling, tanpa sengaja Cakra bertemu dengan Mona (Zoe Jackson) sahabat perempuannya saat kuliah.

programme.title: Unnatural
programme.desc: Perubahan iklim dunia membuat sebuah perusahaan melakukan rekayasa genetik pada sekelompok beruang kutub Alaska yang ternyata memberi dampak nan mengerikan dan mematikan.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: Di Barat yang tak ada aturan hukum, The Cowboys, kakak-beradik pembunuh dan pencuri nan terkenal, menguasai wilayah tersebut dengan tinju brutal dan senjata api. Namun, takdir akhirnya datang menghampiri mereka.

programme.title: The Curse Of Sleeping Beauty
programme.desc: Seorang pria mewarisi rumah leluhurnya dan sebuah kutukan kuno yang berasal dari Perang Salib.

programme.title: Exists
programme.desc: Sekelompok teman menjalajahi kawasan hutan terpencil di Texas untuk bersenang-senang di akhir pekan, namun mereka dibuntuti oleh Bigfoot.

programme.title: The Devil's Trap
programme.desc: Seorang pendeta melakukan perjalanan untuk menyelidiki seorang tukang giling yang dicurigai bekerja sama dengan iblis.

programme.title: Come Out Fighting
programme.desc: Berlatar saat Perang Dunia II, sekelompok tentara Angkatan Darat Amerika dikirim dalam misi rahasia untuk menemukan komandan mereka yang hilang.

programme.title: Come Out Fighting
programme.desc: Berlatar saat Perang Dunia II, sekelompok tentara Angkatan Darat Amerika dikirim dalam misi rahasia untuk menemukan komandan mereka yang hilang.

programme.title: The Folks
programme.desc: Setelah pemakaman suaminya, Mary menerima kunjungan dari saudara laki-laki dan ibunya, yang belum pernah ia temui sebelumnya. Mary mengetahui bahwa kerabat mendiang suaminya berbahaya bagi dirinya dan putranya, Tony.

programme.title: Road To Hell
programme.desc: Seorang prajurit yang telah lama berperang menjadi gila karena ia tidak lagi percaya pada tujuan atau kebenaran di balik pembunuhan itu. Ia pulang ke dunia surealis, mencari cinta pertamanya dan satu-satunya dari masa mudanya, percaya bahwa wanita itu akan menyelamatkannya dari iblis-iblis dalam dirinya. Dalam perjalanan menuju Edge City, ia bertemu dengan dua pembunuh berantai yang menggoda dan menentang upayanya untuk menemukan cintanya dan penebusan yang sangat ia dambakan.

programme.title: The Great War
programme.desc: Pada hari-hari terakhir Perang Dunia Pertama, sekelompok tentara AS dikirim ke belakang garis musuh untuk menyelamatkan sebuah peleton yang tersesat.

programme.title: The Curse Of The Clown Motel
Any Bullet Will Do
programme.desc: Pada tahun 1876, seorang pemburu bayaran melacak saudaranya sendiri di seluruh Montana dengan bantuan seorang pemburu hewan ilegal.

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Tersiksa oleh masa lalunya, seorang petugas kebersihan bernama Clean mencoba menjalani kehidupan yang tenang. Tak lama kemudian, ia dipaksa untuk berdamai dengan kekerasan masa lalunya.

programme.title: No Visitors
programme.desc: Lewis Cutterman, dokter bedah terhormat, menyimpan rahasia kelam. Keluarganya membius tamu lalu memakan tubuhnya sedikit demi sedikit untuk memperdagangkan organ demi pasien kaya.

programme.title: Born To Dance
programme.desc: Tu adalah seorang pemuda ambisius yang bermimpi menjadi penari hip-hop profesional. Kala sang ayah melarangnya, ia malah memutuskan untuk menjadikan tarian sebagai jalan hidupnya.

programme.title: Straw Dogs (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Penulis skenario asal Los Angeles, David Sumner, pindah bersama istrinya ke kampung halaman istrinya di wilayah Selatan Amerika Serikat. Di sana, ketegangan meningkat di antara mereka, dan konflik yang sedang berkembang dengan penduduk setempat menjadi ancaman bagi mereka berdua.

programme.title: The International (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Seorang agen Interpol dan seorang jaksa AS bekerja sama untuk menghentikan pendanaan terorisme oleh sebuah bank.

programme.title: Click (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Seorang arsitek yang gila kerja menemukan sebuah remote universal yang memungkinkannya untuk mempercepat dan memundurkan waktu ke berbagai bagian dalam hidupnya. Komplikasi muncul ketika remote tersebut mulai mengesampingkan pilihannya.

programme.title: The Emoji Movie
programme.desc: Gene, emoji multiekspresi, memulai perjalanan untuk menjadi emoji normal.

programme.title: Envy
programme.desc: Seorang pria menjadi semakin iri terhadap kesuksesan yang baru diraih temannya.

programme.title: Arena
programme.desc: David Lord terpaksa masuk ke dunia brutal arena gladiator modern, tempat para pria bertarung hingga mati demi menghibur jutaan penonton di dunia maya.

programme.title: Zombieland: Double Tap
programme.desc: Columbus, Tallahassee, Wichita, dan Little Rock pindah ke jantung Amerika saat mereka menghadapi segerombolan zombie yang berevolusi, sesama penyintas, dan kekacauan dalam keluarga mereka.

programme.title: Zombieland
programme.desc: Seorang siswa pemalu, seorang pria bersenjata dan sepasang kakak-beradik bekerja sama dalam melawan zombie yang mewabah di Amerika.

programme.title: Pineapple Express

programme.title: Kung Fu Stuntmen

programme.title: My Date With A Vampire
programme.desc: Pemburu iblis Ma Siu Ling memecahkan misteri supranatural dan melawan roh jahat. Selama penyelidikannya, ia bertemu dengan detektif misterius Fong, yang masa lalunya yang tersembunyi terkait dengan takdir kelam. Meskipun awalnya saling tidak percaya, keduanya menjadi sekutu dan bergabung untuk menghadapi kejahatan mengerikan yang mengancam kota.

programme.desc: Wu Song mengetahui perselingkuhan kakak iparnya dengan seorang pria kaya bernama Ximen Qing. programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: Sebuah keluarga sederhana dari kota besar memutuskan untuk meninggalkan gemerlap perkotaan dan kembali ke desa demi anak mereka yang takut pergi ke sekolah. Di desa, mereka berinteraksi dengan teman, tetangga, dan hewan-hewan sekitar, menyebabkan berbagai situasi canggung dan lucu yang tak berujung. Namun, di tengah-tengah segala kekonyolan itu, juga terjadi momen kebersamaan yang menyentuh hati, di mana tawa dan air mata berdampingan. programme.desc: Berawal dari lahirnya rayyanza malik ahmad (cipung), putra kedua dari raffi ahmad dan nagita slavina yang membawa kebahagiaan untuk semua orang, bahkan sepupunya zayn dan zuney. Namun, berbeda dengan Rafathar, si anak sulung, dia justru cemburu karena merasa seluruh perhatian diambil oleh cipung. hingga keajaiban terjadi saat Fairy dust mengenai cipung, rafathar, Zayn, dan Zuney. Fairy dust mengubah para bayi menjadi bayi-bayi ajaib dan membawa mereka ke dunia boba, tempat untuk anak-anak di mana semua keajaiban bisa terjadi dan tanpa diketahui orang dewasa. Sejak saat itulah petualangan dimulai. programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks adalah serial animasi pendidikan untuk anak-anak prasekolah yang mengajarkan konsep matematika melalui karakter blok angka yang hidup dan berpetualang. Setiap blok angka memiliki nilai numeriknya sendiri dan memiliki kepribadian yang unik. mereka bergabung dan berinteraksi satu sama lain untuk memecahkan masalah matematika sambil mengajarkan konsep dasar matematika seperti penjumlahan, pengurangan, perkalian, pembagian, dan konsep lainnya. Setiap episode dari "numberblocks" biasanya menampilkan cerita pendek di mana blok angka bekerja sama untuk menyelesaikan suatu tugas atau menghadapi tantangan matematika. Melalui lagu-lagu, cerita-cerita yang menarik, dan visual yang cerah, serial ini bertujuan untuk memperkenalkan dan memperkuat pemahaman anak-anak tentang angka dan konsep matematika dasar dengan cara yang menyenangkan dan interaktif.

Dengan bantuan pink star, peri penjaga bubblegem yang sedang tertidur, purple berubah wujud. programme.title: Tian Tian
programme.desc: Tian Tian

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: Sebuah keluarga sederhana dari kota besar memutuskan untuk meninggalkan gemerlap perkotaan dan kembali ke desa demi anak mereka yang takut pergi ke sekolah. Di desa, mereka berinteraksi dengan teman, tetangga, dan hewan-hewan sekitar, menyebabkan berbagai situasi canggung dan lucu yang tak berujung. Namun, di tengah-tengah segala kekonyolan itu, juga terjadi momen kebersamaan yang menyentuh hati, di mana tawa dan air mata berdampingan. Tiantian, sang anak yang berusia enam tahun, penuh dengan rasa ingin tahu dan cinta akan dunia, mulai berkembang menjadi pribadi yang sehat, mandiri, dan percaya diri di tengah keindahan pedesaan.

programme.desc: Berawal dari lahirnya rayyanza malik ahmad (cipung), putra kedua dari raffi ahmad dan nagita slavina yang membawa kebahagiaan untuk semua orang, bahkan sepupunya zayn dan zuney. Namun, berbeda dengan Rafathar, si anak sulung, dia justru cemburu karena merasa seluruh perhatian diambil oleh cipung. hingga keajaiban terjadi saat Fairy dust mengenai cipung, rafathar, Zayn, dan Zuney. Fairy dust mengubah para bayi menjadi bayi-bayi ajaib dan membawa mereka ke dunia boba, tempat untuk anak-anak di mana semua keajaiban bisa terjadi dan tanpa diketahui orang dewasa. Sejak saat itulah petualangan dimulai. Bersama para boba, makhluk yang bekerja di sana, mereka menciptakan alatalat ajaib hingga bertemu berbagai makhluk menakjubkan seperti monster tauge, para virus, zombie, manusia salju, hingga bertemu supercool yang meningkatkan adrenalin petualangan mereka.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Siang - Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua saudara perempuan bernama Andien dan Elsa. Keduanya tidak menyadari bahwa mereka sama-sama mencintai pria yang sama, yaitu Nino. Hubungan yang sudah renggang di antara mereka semakin memburuk setelah Elsa mengetahui bahwa Nino berencana menikahi Andien. Setelah menikah, Elsa memfitnah Andien hingga diceraikan Nino. Ditengah luka tersebut Andien bertemu dengan Aldebaran yang sengaja mendekati Andien untuk membalas dendam adiknya. Namun dengan kebaikan hati Andien, perlahan Aldebaran melihat kebenaran dan mulai jatuh cinta pada Andien

programme.title: Ternyata Ini Cinta (RCTI)

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terbaik Itu Kamu
programme.desc: Sera, putri pemilik perusahaan kosmetik Novelle Beauty, dijebak sebagai pembunuh Bram oleh tunangannya sendiri, Marvin, dan mantan kekasih Marvin, Clara. Akibat kesaksian palsu mereka, Sera dipenjara selama lima tahun dan kehilangan ayahnya, sementara sang adik, Wilda, membencinya karena percaya Sera telah membunuh kekasihnya. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. programme.title: Samudra Cinta
programme.desc: Kisah bermula di dalam rumah sederhana Rusdi dan Bi Lila melakukan kesalahan dalam hubungan yang terlarang kemudian melahirkan bayi mungil bernama Cinta. meskipun terlahir dari seorang wanita penghibur Cinta beruntung bertemu dengan Samudra yang tulus sayang kepadanya. Dibintangi oleh Rangga Azof, Mischa Chandrawinta, Dylan Car, Cut Syifa, Angela Gilsha, Ben Kasyafani, Haico Van der Veken, dan lain lainnya

programme.title: Samudra Cinta
programme.desc: Cerita bermula di sebuah rumah sederhana. Rusdi bersama istrinya, Novi, dan ketiga anak mereka, Andra, Novan, dan Vina, sedang berbincang di ruang tamu sambil menonton televisi. Karena Vina tidak bisa tidur, Novi meminta Rusdi mematikan televisi. Saat itulah, mereka mendengar suara tangisan bayi yang seolah berasal dari depan rumah. Karena penasaran, Rusdi dan Novi akhirnya menidurkan Vina di dalam boks bayi, lalu keluar untuk memeriksa keadaan. Saat sampai di depan rumah, Novi dan Rusdi sangat terkejut melihat Lila sedang menggendong seorang bayi. Lila memohon kepada Rusdi untuk merawat anak kandungnya yang bernama Cinta.

Saksikan setiap hari pukul 18.25 WIB.

programme.title: Cinta Seluas Samudra
programme.desc: Maya terjebak dalam pernikahan palsu dengan Andrian, pewaris konglomerat yang perlahan jatuh cinta padanya. Namun, dendam Hana membawa Maya ke jurang dan membuatnya dinyatakan tewas. Saat Maya ternyata masih hidup dan berada di tangan Roni, sebuah konspirasi membuatnya percaya bahwa Andrian telah mengkhianatinya.

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain
programme.desc: Rasa sakit dan cinta di ingatakanku akan terus kekal. Dan Sekarang, cinta itu kembali dengan wajah yang lain..? Wajah Cinta Yang lain dibintangi oleh Dinda Kirana, Ibrahim Risyad, Oka Antara, Aulia Sarah, Andi Anissa, dan Andri Mashadi.

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain
programme.desc: Sebuah pengkhianatan mengubah hidup Asti untuk selamanya. Kehilangan wajah, keluarga, dan kehidupan yang selama ini ia percaya, Asti bangkit dengan identitas baru untuk membongkar konspirasi yang menghancurkan hidupnya. Di balik setiap kebenaran yang terungkap, ia harus memilih antara membalas dendam atau memperjuangkan masa depan anak yang menjadi satu-satunya alasan ia bertahan hidup.

programme.title: Kesetiaan
programme.desc: Nadya (ANGGIKA BOLSTERLI), seorang dosen sukses, telah menikah dengan Pram (OMAR DANIEL). Setelah Pram kehilangan pekerjaan dan berkali-kali gagal membangun bisnis karena insiden kecelakaan di masa lalu, Nadya menjadi tulang punggung keluarga. Merasa rendah diri, Pram berubah menjadi suami toxic yang suka merendahkan, mengontrol, dan selalu cemburu dengan istrinya, apalagi ada Aris (RIONALDO STOCKHORST) mantan pacar Nadya yang juga menjadi dosen di kampus, semakin membuat Pram menjadi insecure sebagai suami Nadya. Namun semua berubah ketika Nadya membawa Citra (KEYSHA ANGELICA), mahasiswinya yang sedang mengalami kesulitan hidup untuk tinggal di kostan milik Pram dan Nadya. Pram yang merasa minder dengan istrinya ternyata menemukan kenyamanan yang ia dambakan ketika bersama Citra??? Saksikan keseruan ceritanya dalam SINETRON TERBARU KESETIAAN

programme.desc: Seorang polisi yang jujur ​​mencari keadilan bagi orang biasa melawan segala rintangan. Seorang anak laki-laki kaya ingin membalas dendam pada polisi.

programme.title: The King's Warden
programme.desc: Berlatar belakang Dinasti Joseon, dan konon mengisahkan tentang raja keenam Joseon, Danjong, yang diasingkan ke Yeongwol, Provinsi Gangwon.

programme.title: My Puppy
programme.desc: Seorang calon pengantin pria pergi bersama temannya guna mencari pemilik baru untuk anak anjingnya.

programme.title: The Old Woman With The Knife
programme.desc: Seorang pembunuh bayaran tua yang mahir menyingkirkan penjahat terburuk di masyarakat bertemu dengan seorang anak didik muda yang bersemangat untuk mempelajari keahlian tersebut. Saat mereka menjalin ikatan yang tak terduga, pembunuh veteran itu menemukan tujuan baru di masa senja hidupnya yang penuh kekerasan dan rutinitas.

programme.title: Hi-Five
programme.desc: Hi-Five mengisahkan lima orang biasa yang hidupnya berubah setelah menerima transplantasi organ dari donor misterius yang sama. Tidak lama kemudian, mereka menyadari bahwa transplantasi tersebut memberikan kemampuan luar biasa yang berbeda-beda pada masing-masing orang. Saat masih berusaha memahami kekuatan baru mereka, muncul seorang pria berbahaya yang ingin menguasai kemampuan tersebut demi ambisinya sendiri. Terpaksa bersatu meskipun memiliki latar belakang dan kepribadian yang berbeda, kelima tokoh ini menjalani petualangan penuh aksi, humor, dan tantangan untuk menghadapi ancaman yang mengincar mereka. Dengan nuansa superhero khas Korea, film ini menghadirkan kisah seru tentang kerja sama, keberanian, dan persahabatan.

programme.title: Super Wings
programme.sub-title: Eye on the Sky / Missing in Morocco
programme.desc: Jett delivers an incubator to a girl named Nambayar in Mongolia who has found a big egg. The egg hatches into a baby dinosaur! Jett uses a time machine to try and find the baby's mom. While playing at World Aircraft, the Super Pets accidentally damage a new satellite dish. Jett delivers a robot puppy to a little girl named Lien in Singapore. But Lien wanted a real puppy, not a robot.

programme.desc: Jett delivers an incubator to a girl named Nambayar in Mongolia who has found a big egg. The egg hatches into a baby dinosaur! Jett uses a time machine to try and find the baby's mom. But Lien wanted a real puppy, not a robot.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Straight A's
programme.desc: Compelled by his mother's ghost, a former addict (Ryan Phillippe, "Crash") returns home to face his first love (Anna Paquin, "The Piano"), who happens to be his brother's wife.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Mysteria
programme.desc: Fighting to finish his script for a producer (Billy Zane), screenwriter Aleister (Robert Miano) finds inspiration amid a murder investigation led by Captain McCarthy (Michael Rooker) and his interrogator (Danny Glover).

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies play a slide game before watching Becky and Jed look for eggs on their farm. Then their mum cooks them for their tea. In Teletubbyland, the Lion and Bear play their hide and seek game.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Alex Pascall and some children sing to their dolls to rock them to sleep. Laa-Laa wants to sing a lovely song, but Tinky Winky is crunching his Tubby Toast too loudly!

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies march up and down a hill and then they watch some children explore the colour pink. Tinky Winky doesn't know how to make Tubby Custard.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Laa-Laa dances with her ball. A little boy tells us why he likes to live in his block of flats. A balloon appears in Teletubbyland. The Teletubbies follow a balloon.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies giggle as they play their 'Through the Arch' game. The windmill stops them to watch a little girl and her dad go for a walk in the town.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies line up to say 'Eh-oh' and then watch Matthew and Mark feed a baby calf. The Teletubbies play a game to see who can eat their Tubby Custard the slowest, but Po can't wait and eats her Tubby Custard very fast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies and some children watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the Naughty Pig. Dipsy's hat keeps blowing away and he has to chase it all over Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa run into Home Hill to say 'Eh-oh', but where 's Po? Some children help their dad to wash his car. They get very wet and soapy.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies crawl through the arch in Home Hill and watch Alex Pascall and some children sing 'Handy Hands'.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children play with balls of different shapes and sizes. In Teletubbyland, something happens to Dipsy's hat.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: It's time for the Teletubbies to do their exercises. A voice trumpet rises and the Teletubbies stretch up and down to it's instructions.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number two. Dipsy and Laa-Laa are eating Tubby Toast. They play the game 'Two Little Teletubbies', but while they are playing the Noo-Noo tidies up their Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies take turns to stand on a hill, in front of the house, next to a tree under a cloud. Andy Brown and some children visit some giraffes. The animals march through Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are eating Tubby Toast. They stop to watch Amy making pasta. A ball of string appears in Teletubbyland. Po knocks the string in to the air with her scooter and it makes a stringy mess all over Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky calls the other Tubbies to come and watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story about the naughty sock. The Tubby Toast machine makes a tower of tubby toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children looking at penguins waddling and swimming. In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies play walk fast and slow, far and near and other different ways.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies play 'Boo', but stop to watch Ned help his dad plant and water some geraniums. In Teletubbyland, nine pretty flowers and a watering can appear.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies love playing on the slide. They stop to watch Andy Brown and some children digging in the sand for crabs.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Samira and her friends show the Teletubbies their gymnastic routines. The Teletubbies do their own gymnastics.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch Matthew and James help their uncle milk the cows. In Teletubbyland, the Tubby Custard machine isn't working, so they sing a special 'Tubby Custard' song. Then, the Tubby Custard machine works again.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet appears and the Teletubbies dance, before watching two girls do some Flamenco dancing with their teacher. It's time for the Teletubbies to wash their feet. They love using their Tubby Sponges.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch a little boy peel and mash some eggs for an egg mayonnaise sandwich. The Teletubbies laugh when they make a tune whilst eating their Tubby Custard.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance around the trees and watch some children drum with their friend Norris. Tinky Winky dance on the roof of Home Hill and wakes up the other Tubbies.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Dipsy says "Eh-oh" and runs off to find the other Tubbies. They watch some children make fantastic animals from papermache.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch a little girl who loves monkeys help her mum feed them in a zoo. Tinky Winky sits down to eat some Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky says "Eh-oh". The Teletubbies and some children watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be the Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty hat. The Teletubbies are very happy when they find their favourite things to play with.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies are trying to be quiet. They watch Oscar read the story of the Gingerbread Boy to his brother Felix. A voice trumpet appears and sings the nursery rhyme.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Po fetches the other to watch Andy Brown and two children look for some rabbits. In Teletubbyland, Tinky Winky is looking for Po. He looks for her everywhere, but she is hiding from him. When he finds her all the Tubbies dance a happy dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance an up and down dance. They watch some children painting pictures and patterns on to eggs. In Teletubbyland, Laa-Laa dances with her ball until the magical tree appears.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa sit down to eat some Tubby Custard. Po wants some too. She tries to eat the other's Tubby Custard, but they won't let her.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch a little boy show us how to make a Turban. The Tubbies go for a walk, but Po, Laa-Laa and Dipsy want to play with their favourite things.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises and teaches the Teletubbies a nursery rhyme. Then they watch Becky go for a ride on a Tram. Po rides her scooter too fast and knocks the other Tubbies over.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch some children are playing football in the park. Laa-Laa and Po love playing with the ball. While they play they sing a song about the ball.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies pop up from behind a hill to watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty sausage. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po go for a walk, so Laa-Laa decides to dance a secret dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies want to go to sleep, but Tinky Winky finds Po already asleep in his bed. So he goes to look for somewhere else to sleep.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number three. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa go for a walk. They count three trees and three flowers and Po follows behind counting too.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are asleep when a voice trumpet appears singing the rhyme 'Frére Jacques'. The Teletubbies laugh and call "Again, again!"

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies see a little girl and her brother who love salad. They go shopping in a market a market with their grandma to buy some salad to eat.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch two boys make Chinese Lanterns with their uncle. In Teletubbyland, it is time for Tubby Toast, but where has Laa-Laa's toast gone?

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises and makes the Teletubbies laugh. They watch some children exploring the colour green. The Teletubbies love green.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies and some children learn about the colour blue. In Teletubbyland Po is watching the blue sky when it begins to rain.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Noo-Noo tidies up Home hill before the Teletubbies slide up the slide to watch Natalie tell us about her brother's christening.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch Sarah and Mark give their sheep a winter-feed. In Teletubbyland, the Teletubbies cannot decide whether to have Tubby Custard or Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies leave their favourite things to watch some boys spinning some spinning tops to celebrate the Hanukah festival. Tinky Winky wears the skirt on his head to do a very special round and round dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance a jumping dance before stopping to watch Yvette wash up her plastic cups and saucers. The Teletubbies have a very messy day. So Noo-Noo has to tidy everything up.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are asleep, but Noo-Noo tidies up their blankets. They stop chasing him to watch some children learn about the number five. A flashing light appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises to tell the Teletubbies 'Christmas is a Coming'. They hurry up the slide to see some children decorate a Christmas Tree. The Teletubbies get excited when their own Christmas Tree appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children making Christmas cards. Laa-Laa's present is some lovely decorations. When Noo-Noo tidies them up they tickle his throat, so he throws them out to decorate Home Hill.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Two children are making Christmas crackers for each other. Dipsy is very pleased to find his present is a cracker. He looks for someone to pull the cracker. It makes a lovely pink bang and the Teletubbies laugh when they fall over.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A group of children sing some Christmas carols to the Teletubbies. Tinky Winky opens his present to find a beautiful star inside. The Teletubbies follow it all over Teletubbyland, but where will is end up?

Now Brigitte must save her sister and save herself.

programme.title: Ginger Snaps II: Unleashed
programme.desc: A patient (Tatiana Maslany) at a rehabilitation center tries to prevent a young woman (Emily Perkins) from transforming into a werewolf.

programme.title: Ginger Snaps Back: The Beginning
programme.desc: In early 19th-century Canada, orphaned sisters Ginger (Katharine Isabelle) and Brigitte (Emily Perkins) find themselves lost in a forest while riding on horseback. They're rescued by The Hunter (Nathaniel Arcand), a mysterious Native American who takes them back to Fort Bailey. Something strange has happened there, however. The few settlers who remain are suspicious of outsiders and keep tight-lipped about the situation, but Ginger soon discovers their secret for herself.

programme.title: Bitch Slap
programme.desc: Three bad girls, a stripper, a drug-runner, and a power broker, arrive in the desert to extort money from an underworld kingpin, but things quickly spin out of control as allegiances change.

programme.title: All Roads Lead to Rome
programme.desc: An uptight woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) reconnects with an old flame (Raoul Bova) after her rebellious daughter (Rosie Day) and the man's mother (Claudia Cardinale) run away together.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: The owner (Amy Poehler) of an independent candy shop and the corporate stooge (Paul Rudd) who has been sent to shut her down begin an unlikely romance.

programme.title: From Prada to Nada
programme.desc: Spoiled sisters Nora (Camilla Belle) and Mary (Alexa Vega) Dominguez have a life of wealth and privilege in Beverly Hills. However, their world crashes when their father dies suddenly. Now penniless, the two have to move in with their Aunt Aurelia (Adriana Barraza) in East L.A.'s Boyle Heights. Striving to work through the culture clash, Nora and Mary begin to embrace their Latin heritage, discover romance, and learn the meaning of family.

programme.title: Lars and the Real Girl
programme.desc: Extremely shy Lars (Ryan Gosling) finds it impossible to make friends or socialize. His brother (Paul Schneider) and sister-in-law (Emily Mortimer) worry about him, so when he announces that he has a girlfriend he met on the Internet, they are overjoyed. But Lars' new lady is a life-size plastic woman. On the advice of a doctor (Patricia Clarkson), his family and the rest of the community go along with his delusion.

programme.title: Mannequin Two: On the Move
programme.desc: Although Jason (William Ragsdale) works as a department store clerk, he is also a reincarnated prince. Long ago, his beloved Jessie (Kristy Swanson) was snatched away from him by an evil wizard (Terry Kiser) who used his powers to transform her into wooden statue. Now Jessie is in Jason's department store as a mannequin. When he encounters her, she awakens from her thousand-year sleep. They quickly revive their romance, but the evil wizard has been reincarnated as well, and he's up to no good.

programme.title: Cadillac Man
programme.desc: Car dealer Joey O'Brien (Robin Williams) is spread as thin financially as he is in his love life. He's dating more women than he can remember, and the local toughs he's borrowed money from want it back. In a last-ditch effort to get out of debt, Joey struggles to sell a dozen cars in two days -- a task that becomes difficult when the husband (Tim Robbins) of Joey's secretary (Annabella Sciorra) barges into the dealership with a semi-automatic weapon and takes everyone hostage.

programme.title: Cruel Intentions
programme.desc: Annette (Reese Witherspoon) unwittingly becomes a pawn in Sebastian's (Ryan Phillippe) and Kathryn's (Sarah Michelle Gellar) deliciously diabolical wager of sexual conquest when she writes an article in Seventeen Magazine about how she intends to stay pure until she marries her boyfriend. However, Sebastian gets more than he bargained for as he attempts to woo Annette into his bed.

After her failed suicide attempt, psychiatrist Jonathan Banks (Jude Law) prescribes a series of medications. When Wesley proposes cutting Johnny in on a criminal undertaking, Johnny must choose between a life of crime and a settled future with Ruby.

Based on the novel by Roddy Doyle.

He mixes the perfume into a lotion, which he offers as a gift to Mary and Henry. When they turn up dead, a newspaper reporter (Dave O'Brien) decides to investigate.

When Moussavi's supporters protested Ahmadinejad's declaration of victory, Bahari smuggled footage of the riots to the BBC. He was soon arrested by the Revolutionary Guard and -- led by a man known only as "Rosewater" -- was interrogated and tortured for 118 days.

programme.title: Road Games

programme.title: Agent Red

Though Alex is quite a bit older than Milena, he's attracted to her young, carefree spirit. After shooting down his wife and her lover, he battles a landowner intent on keeping all the town's water for himself. But his deadly ways make him yearn for a belief in God again.

programme.title: Hitman

New interviews with the teenage phenomenon reveal long-awaited answers about his passion for making music, his relationships, and coming of age in the public eye. Chu also includes new concert footage, behind-the-scenes access, and special appearances by manager Scooter Braun, and singers Usher, Ludacris and others.

programme.title: The Bat

As Cornelia implores Dr. Malcolm Wells (Vincent Price) to help her ailing maid, $1 million in the town's bank goes missing. With greed and fear reaching new heights, police Lt. They soon uncover a sinister group of wealthy men who hunt the homeless for sport, paying them $10,000 if they can survive a crosstown journey. When Chance discovers that Natasha's father was one of their victims, he decides to destroy the evil hunters.

programme.desc: In the slums of New York City during the 1920s, petty thief Chris Dubois (Jean-Claude Van Damme) finds himself on the run from the police. At the docks, he hides on an outbound freight ship leaving for Asia. Taken in by the mysterious Lord Dobbs (Roger Moore) as the boat docks in Thailand, Dubois is introduced to the underground world of martial arts fighting. His training culminates in a secret battle between the world's greatest fighters that takes place before a select audience in Tibet.

programme.title: Jet Li's Fearless
programme.desc: After a terrible tragedy, a martial artist (Jet Li) retreats to a remote village to gain a new appreciation for the important things in life, but when he returns to the city to reconcile his past with the present, he gets caught up in a duel to the death defending China's honor.

programme.title: The Eagle
programme.desc: Under the command of Flavius Aquila in A.D. 120, Rome's Ninth Legion marches north carrying its revered eagle emblem and vanishing into the mists. Rumors of the legion's golden eagle appearing in a tribal temple reach Marcus Aquila (Channing Tatum), Flavius' son, 20 years later. Accompanied by his slave (Jamie Bell), Marcus makes a dangerous journey to Scotland to retrieve the hallowed eagle and, in doing so, to restore his father's tarnished honor.

programme.title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy
programme.desc: Black ops specialist Connor Gibson infiltrates a maximum security prison to take down legendary driver Frankenstein in a violent and brutal car race.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
programme.desc: Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky
programme.desc: After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.title: Firestarter

Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop."

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

Only their expert training will allow them to survive a near-impossible mission -- breaking into CIA headquarters.

The girl is no ordinary child; she's a math prodigy who holds in her head a numerical code for which various factions are ready to kill.

programme.title: Redemption
programme.desc: Joey, an alcoholic war veteran assumes a new identity after returning from a traumatic tour in Afghanistan and becomes a vigilante in a bid to atone for his sins.

As Balzary and his squad launch an all-out attack, father and son retreat to a high-tech bunker that has steel walls and advanced weapons.

programme.sub-title: Flame Dragon King! Protect Luffy's Life!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With Luffy and so many of the Straw Hats' allies incapacitated, victory seems inevitable for Doflamingo - but the compassion of Mansherry may be enough to turn the tide and renew their hope - to stop the Birdcage!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With just over a minute to spare, everyone in Dressrosa turns their efforts towards slowing down the Birdcage as it squeezes the life out of the country! Meanwhile, Viola seeks Doflamingo out herself, for a shocking confrontation!
programme.sub-title: As Long as We Breathe! Stop the Deadly Birdcage!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Only a bit more time remains before Luffy returns to the scene! But as time slips by, those who had been roused by Princess Mansherry's powers begin to falter! Meanwhile, Rebecca, under the control of Doflamingo, is about to attack Viola!
programme.sub-title: Dead or Alive! A Fateful Countdown!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy regains enough Haki to face off against Doflamingo, but his health is still poor. With the Birdcage closing in, is there a technique left in his repertoire that is strong enough to take down Doflamingo?
programme.sub-title: Attack on a Celestial! Luffy's King Kong Gun of Anger!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With Doflamingo thoroughly quashed and the Birdcage collapsing, the people of Dressrosa shed tears of joy remembering the hardships they've endured, and the actions taken by Luffy and the others to free them.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Jesus Burgess of the Blackbeard Pirates tries to agitate Sabo, mocking Ace's final words in order to unsettle him enough that he can try to steal the Flare-Flare Fruit! Meanwhile, people of Dressrosa beg King Riku to resume the crown.
programme.sub-title: The Unheard-of! Admiral Fujitora’s Surprising Decision!

programme.title: One Piece

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The combatants in the battle for Dressrosa can finally begin to recoup, but those who stay awake are treated to the story of how Sabo joined the Revolutionary Army!

programme.sub-title: The Brothers' Bond! The Untold Story Behind Luffy and Sabo's Reunion!

programme.title: One Piece

programme.sub-title: The Strongest Creature! One of the Four Emperors - Kaido, King of the Beasts!

programme.title: One Piece

programme.title: One Piece

programme.title: My Best Friends Bouquet

programme.title: June In January

programme.title: The Perfect Pairing

programme.title: Wedding Season

programme.title: The Love Club: Sydney

programme.title: Marrying Father Christmas

programme.title: Christmas Miracle

programme.title: Well Suited for Christmas

programme.title: The Girl Who Escaped: The Kara Robinson Story

programme.title: My Moms Letter From Heaven

Baby's First Sounds invites both of you to share these memorable moments: those precious ''firsts'' that come around once in your baby's lifetime.

When Thanos arrives from outer space and threatens to destroy Earth, the Black Panther leaps into action and defeats him with the help of Earth's Mightiest Heroes. But the situation only gets worse when rogue villains Killmonger and Klaue team up with the Mad Titan to take the fight to Black Panther's homeland! Can the Panther pounce on their perilous plan before Wakanda is pulverized?

programme.title: The Maze Of Amazement
programme.desc: The Knights find themselves trapped in a maze looking for the Book of Deception. But will they actually get their hands on it, or will it keep deceiving them? The Knights travel to the Hill Country in the northern part of Knighton to Axl's home town of DIGGINGTON (where they realize that all of Axl's family look just like him.) While they're there, Merlok 2.0 detects something…one of the Magic Books! It's “The Book of Deception.” They go to find it and discover it ended up under a mountain. And, to make matters worse, the magic book has built a maze around itself to keep it from being found (it is deceptive!) As the NEXO-Knights enter the maze from one side, Jestro enters from the other the Book of Monsters has led him to the maze to get The Book of Deception, too. It's a race through this confusing maze to see who can get the book first. Ava figures out the maze is the Whackman maze from a videogame. After help from Axl's people to defeat Jestro and win the book, the knights discover it's a FAKE BOOK of deception. The Book of Deception created a fake copy of itself!
